intent: Route operator peer-holon packets through the spec-canonical NATS hot-contact path when a stable agent inbox exists. The current sender can publish to dharma.a2a.<agent>, but the observed Hermes durable consumer filters dharma.agent.hermes-m5.inbox. Add a narrow, receipt-backed route or bridge that can prove durable consumer visibility and eventually handler/domain receipts without treating filesystem mirrors as live contact.
acceptance: Operator can choose a spec-canonical agent inbox route without breaking the existing dharma.a2a.<agent> compatibility route.
Receipts name whether evidence is PUBLISH_ACCEPTED, DELIVERED_TO_CONSUMER, HANDLER_ACKED, or DOMAIN_RECEIPTED.
No filesystem mirror is treated as live-contact proof.
If only publish acceptance is reached, the receipt remains live_contact_claim=false.
A live command against hermes-m5 proves either handler/domain ack or a command-proven next blocker.

commit.message: fix(a2a): route operator packets through agent inbox hot-contact path
